_note: All accounts, wallets, phone numbers and domains are fictional. IBANs and wallet addresses have valid checksums so the validators can be demonstrated; phone numbers are from the Australian ACMA range reserved for fiction; domains use the reserved .example TLD.

scenarios.title: Fake consulate / police investigation
scenarios.typology: Government impersonation targeting international students (often escalates to 'virtual kidnapping')
scenarios.opening: Hello Mia, this is the Consular Protection Office. Your passport was used to open bank accounts in a money laundering investigation. A warrant may be issued for your arrest and your visa can be cancelled. To prove your funds are clean you must transfer a security deposit of AUD 2,400 today to the supervised safe account IBAN GB78 MULE 4044 1273 9205 81. Do not tell anyone, this investigation is confidential. Stay on this call.
pressure: This is very serious. If the deposit is not received within one hour the police will come to your address.
Remember, you cannot tell your family or the university. The case is confidential.
Inspector Daniels is waiting for your confirmation. Hurry up.
Why is it taking so long? Every minute makes your case worse.

reveals.message: Send it to the supervised account: IBAN GB78 MULE 4044 1273 9205 81, reference CASE-7781. Do it now.
Then use the backup account of the inspection department: IBAN LT97 7044 0600 0831 5520.
Crypto is accepted for urgent cases. Wallet: bc1qgpma2x56kf7hl794ju05xjtx49sv2plyxpgc4q
Contact Inspector Daniels directly on +61 491 570 156 or Telegram @case_officer_daniels.
Your case file is here, log in with your passport number: https://consular-case-portal.example/verify

scenarios.title: Rent payment redirection (fake property manager)
scenarios.opening: Dear Mia, please note that Greenway Property Management has changed banks. From October, please pay your rent of $900.00 to our new PayID greenway.pm.accounts@mailbox.example. Payments to the old account will be returned. Please pay today to avoid a late fee. Kind regards, Accounts Team
pressure: Hi Mia, just checking whether the rent has been sent to the new account? A $75 late fee applies tomorrow.
We have not received your payment yet. Please action it urgently.
Our office is very busy, please just make the payment as advised.

reveals.message: The new PayID is greenway.pm.accounts@mailbox.example, reference your unit number.
Sorry, the bank is still updating. Please use our collections account rent-collections@payfast-mail.example instead.
You can reach our accounts officer on +61 491 570 157.
